title: Shinonome Akito — Unchanging Summer Festival〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: The Sounds of a Summer Festival!

rows.Line: Shinonome Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Okay, I should probably head off to see Len soon.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I thought we got rid of my soccer ball ages ago. I didn't realize mom kept it all this time.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Looks like it still holds air.
It should be fine if we're just doing some juggling...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh...
Hehe. It's you, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Stop right there.
Since you're going out...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I have work, so I won't be back until tonight.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You do? Ugh, I was hoping to have you get me something from the convenience store.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Also...
Why are you talking a soccer ball to work?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
This is for something else.
I promised a friend that I'd teach them how to juggle.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
So go to the store yourself.
Later.
bgm_area00003
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
She almost got me again...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, hey! There you are!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hiya!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, so it's both Kagamines today.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yup! Len said that you'd be teaching him how to juggle a soccer ball today, Akito, so I came to see what's up!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, let's get started already!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, relax.
First, try going for ten in a row.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wait, just ten times? That's easy!
Here, gimme that ball!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Go for it.
Toya, Rin, you two might want to keep your distance.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So just keep it going up and down with my feet...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And one...! Huh? What?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Haha! There it goes!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Len, if you don't kick it directly up, you're gonna have a tough time getting up to ten.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I know!
Here we go. This time I'll...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What?! I thought it kicked it upright. Why did it go that way?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You don't have to send it that high into the air. Also, use the top of your foot, not your toes.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Top of my foot... Top of my foot... Okay...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yes, it went where I wanted!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Okay, that was good.
Try not to forget what you just did.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And try to stretch your legs out a little more when you're about to kick it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That way, you'll be able to control where it goes better.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Okay, got it!
Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You can do it, Len!
I'll keep count for you!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, there you all are.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hello, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hello to you too. Thank you for looking after Len like this. I brought you all some drinks in return.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I feel like you'd be a good big brother, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I think so too.
You really seemed to enjoy teaching Len back there.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Me as a big brother?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I probably shouldn't say this, but it might be nice to have a younger sibling instead of an older one...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. You have an older sister.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes, I do. She's only a year older than me, but she treats me like her personal servant or errand boy. It's awful.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. That does sound rough.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But they're very close.
They even call each other by their names, almost as if they're friends.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, Toya, hold up!
Alright, we call each other by our names, but how does that mean we're close?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Don't give me that look.
I just refuse to call her big sis or whatever is all.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is that so?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes. Would you call someone that if they made you their errand boy or pack mule or whatever?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I still probably would...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. That I'd expect from you, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Four, five...!
Keep it up, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe! Yeah, I'll be up to ten in... Oh no!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oww!
It landed on my head...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Len, are you okay?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, it got you right on your nose.
It's all red now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It barely missed the top of my foot, but I'll be fine, really!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I was on a good pace, so I should be able to juggle it ten times soon!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay! You can do it, Len!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If you say so. Just try to be careful though.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Akito, your cheeks and knees are all scraped up again!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
I happened during soccer practice.
This is pretty normal, you know?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
Hey, where are you going?!
Come back here. Let me at least disinfect your wounds.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: No way, you're terrible at doing that.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Well, if you hate it so much, why don't you try coming home without any cuts or scrapes? You must be terrible too, if you're getting hurt all the time.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Also, why's your nose all red? Did you decide to be a reindeer out of season?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
Shut up!
This guy on my team messed up a pass and...!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Okay, whatever. Just come back here and sit next to me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Akito...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Uh, no...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I was just thinking about when I got all cut up, and Ena patched me up. She was mad about how I didn't want her to, but she did it anyway.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In those situations, you can really tell that you two are related.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But that's ancient history.

rows.Speaker: Len's Voice
rows.Line: Akito! I think I can get up to ten really soon! Is there anything else I should be doing?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I'll be right there!
